correctness.rationale: Compute shell Gram G(x,y)=2^(−n)[1+s+((s²−n)/2)] with s=n−2dist(x,y), and expand as constant + point-incidence + pair-incidence kernels. On the k-slice with 2≤k≤n−2, two-subset incidence columns are independent: swap fixed vertices among k-sets forces row differences constant and then zero. Johnson sectors have dimensions 1,n−1,n(n−3)/2, and the bandwidth operator has n+1 zero modes. Incidence eigenvalues yield displayed a0,a1,a2, all positive. Independently factored every pairwise difference: a0−a1=((t−n)²−4(n−1))/(2(n−1)(n−2)); a1−a2=(n²−t)(t−1)/(n(n−1)(n−3)); a0−a2=((n−4)t²+(2n+4)t+n(n−2)(n−6))/(2n(n−2)(n−3)). Parity and interior shell range exactly force square n−1 and listed small exceptions. Rechecked algebra symbolically; stored checker finite 35 shells and n≤500 not substituted for proof.
